user.title: Sentinelle Ecowitt
user.description: Select the entities from your existing Ecowitt station (already set up in Home Assistant) to use for predictions.

crop.title: Monitored crop
crop.description: Frost thresholds depend on the crop and its stage: an apple tree tolerates -18 °C when dormant but is damaged at -2 °C in full bloom. Pick your crop so alerts use real critical temperatures (Washington State University T10/T90 tables). The stage can then be changed at any time from the "Phenological stage" entity.

data.powdery_mildew_rain_penalty: Powdery mildew: account for the inhibiting effect of rain

fallback.title: Backup sources (optional)
fallback.description: If you use the MeteoSwiss integration (or another official station), you can point to its real-time sensors here. They automatically take over whenever an Ecowitt sensor is missing or fails. Leave empty to rely on your Ecowitt station only.

init.title: Update configuration
init.description: Ecowitt sensors, monitored crop, then optional backup sources.

data.powdery_mildew_rain_penalty: Powdery mildew: account for the inhibiting effect of rain

log_treatment.name: Log a treatment
log_treatment.description: Records a spray application and works out how long the crop stays protected.

residual_days.name: Residual (days)
residual_days.description: Protection duration stated by the manufacturer.

reset_powdery_mildew_index.name: Reset powdery mildew index
reset_powdery_mildew_index.description: Sets the Gubler-Thomas index back to zero.
